record.name: Gladly
record.one_liner: Customer service and helpdesk platform for customer interactions and support.
record.access_note: Gladly requires contacting sales or a CSM to purchase and set up an account and sandbox environment.
record.api_note: Covers core helpdesk objects like customer profiles, agent status, answers, and conversations.
record.blocker_note: An active commercial enterprise relationship with Gladly is required to access the platform and API tokens.

evidence.quote: Gladly API uses token-based Basic Authentication.
